map.19 项评分（0~3），得分越高表示睡眠质量越差，0~21 量表。: 19 scored items on a 0-3 scale, where a higher score means worse sleep quality, on a 0-21 scale.
map.PSQI 评估「过去一个月」的睡眠，由 7 个成分构成，每成分 0–3 分：①主: The PSQI assesses sleep over the "past month" through 7 components, each scored 0-3: (1) subjective sleep quality, (2) sleep latency (take the higher of the frequency and the minute score), (3) actual sleep duration, (4) sleep efficiency (actual sleep ÷ time in bed), (5) sleep disturbance (sum of 7 interference types), (6) hypnotic medication, (7) daytime functioning. Adding the 7 gives a global score of 0-21: 5 or below is fairly good sleep, 6-10 a mild to moderate problem, 11-15 a clear problem, 16-21 a serious problem. Everything runs in the browser and no data is uploaded.
map.按真实情况作答，点选项或填写即可；可用键盘 1–4 / ← →: Answer based on your real situation by clicking an option or filling in a value; you can also use keys 1-4 / ← →
map.题号速览（点任意题号可回去改答案）: Question number overview (click any number to go back and change that answer)
map.PSQI 评估的是「过去一个月」的整体睡眠，不是某一晚: The PSQI assesses your overall sleep over the "past month", not a single night
map.时间类题目按你通常的作息填写；频度类从「没有」到「每周 3 次及以上」选一档: Answer the time-related items based on your usual routine; for the frequency items pick one level from "none" to "3 or more nights a week"
map.第 13 题（其他原因）仅作记录、不计分: Item 13 (other reasons) is recorded only and is not scored
map.答题进度仅保存在本机浏览器，点「重新测试」即可清空，数据不会上传: Your progress is stored only in this local browser. Click "Restart test" to clear it; no data is uploaded
map.睡眠全面评估：当「睡不好」但说不清哪里出问题时，用 7 个成分定位是入睡慢、易醒: Full sleep assessment: when you "sleep badly" but cannot say what is wrong, use the 7 components to locate whether it is slow sleep onset, frequent waking or low efficiency.
map.失眠就诊前准备：带着近一个月的 PSQI 结果去门诊，能帮助医生快速判断睡眠结构: Preparing for an insomnia clinic visit: bring your PSQI result for the past month to the appointment so the doctor can judge your sleep structure quickly.
map.用药 / 行为治疗评估：干预前后各测一次，比较全局分与单项分的变化。: Evaluating medication or behavioural treatment: measure once before and once after the intervention and compare the change in the global score and in individual components.
map.7 个成分分别说明什么: What each of the 7 components means
map.成分 1 主观质量、2 入睡时长、3 睡眠时长、4 睡眠效率（实际睡时÷在床时长: Component 1 subjective quality, 2 sleep latency, 3 sleep duration, 4 sleep efficiency (actual sleep ÷ time in bed), 5 sleep disturbance, 6 sleep medication, 7 daytime function, each 0-3 for a total of 0-21. A score of 5 or more suggests poor sleep quality.
map.用「实际睡着小时数 ÷ 躺在床上总小时数 ×100%」。比如躺 8 小时只睡 6: Use "actual hours asleep ÷ total hours in bed × 100%". For example, lying in bed for 8 hours and sleeping only 6 gives an efficiency of 75%, which lowers the score of component 4.
map.为什么「在床时间长」反而可能扣分？: Why can a long time in bed cost you points?
map.因为躺很久却睡不着会降低睡眠效率。这提醒我们：睡不着就起身，比硬躺在床上更有利。: Because lying a long time without falling asleep lowers sleep efficiency. It is a reminder that when you cannot sleep you are better off getting up than staying in bed.
